# Unlimited Wars and Claims

**Version 1.0** · for Crusader Kings III 1.20.* · [Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3820523343) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [All versions](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=unlimited-wars-and-claims&expanded=true)

Take several titles in one war, press several claims in one war, use the de jure casus belli without Divine Right, and declare war with your armies already raised.

## What it does

Four game rules, each **Off** / **Players** (default) / **Everyone**:

- **Several titles in one war** — pick several titles as the war's objective, where the game normally allows one.
- **Several claims in one war** — press several claims in one war without Chronicle Writing (your own claims) or Divine Right (claims for others).
- **De jure wars** — use the de jure casus belli without Divine Right.
- **War with raised armies** — declare a new war while your armies are raised, as long as none stands in the defender's lands (the game's own rule for the governments allowed to do this).

On **Players**, only you qualify; the AI still plays by the normal rules. On **Everyone**, the AI qualifies too. **Off** is vanilla behaviour.

## Built on the game's own rules

A casus belli can only be modded by replacing it whole, which is why mods like this tend to break, or quietly undo the base game's changes, every time CK3 updates. This mod's 16 casus belli files and its one war-trigger file are **generated from CK3 1.20's own**, with only the rule checks added. Nothing the base game added is lost: By God Alone's changes and every expansion's own wars all work as Paradox intended.

## Credit

The idea comes from [Allow Multiple Claims and Unlimited Wars](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2453372701). This is a fresh build of the same idea; none of the original's files are used.

## Compatibility

- Built for **CK3 1.20 "Crozier"** (By God Alone).
- **Replaces Allow Multiple Claims and Unlimited Wars.** Do not run both.
- Conflicts with any other mod that replaces one of these 17 files: *00_claim.txt, 00_conquest.txt, 00_dejure_war.txt, 00_event_war.txt, 00_invasion_war.txt, 00_nomadic_conquest.txt, 00_religious_war.txt, 01_fp1_wars.txt, 03_fp2_wars.txt, 05_fp3_wars.txt, 06_ce1_wars.txt, 07_ep3_admin_cbs.txt, 07_ep3_wars.txt, 09_mpo_wars.txt, 10_tgp_china_wars.txt, 10_tgp_japan_wars.txt, and the scripted triggers' 00_war_and_peace_triggers.txt*. Whichever loads last wins.
- Safe to add or remove mid-game.
- Changes no achievement-relevant rules, but, as with any mod, check the launcher for achievement compatibility.

## Install

- **Steam Workshop:** subscribe on the Workshop page above.
- **Manually, any version:** download `unlimited-wars-and-claims-v<version>.zip` from the [releases](https://github.com/nchelix/ck3-mods-public/releases?q=unlimited-wars-and-claims&expanded=true) and extract it into `Documents/Paradox Interactive/Crusader Kings III/mod/`, then enable it in the launcher.
